name: Debezium Open Source Change Data Capture
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source database change data capture connectors and Debezium Server for streaming committed row changes to supported sinks; no software subscription or vendor usage quota.
watch_out: Requires database replication/log privileges, connector runtime (such as Kafka Connect or Debezium Server), message broker or sink and monitoring. Hosted infrastructure, database storage and broker operations may cost money; Debezium trademarks are separate from the software license.
